scope: Plain-language presentation copy only. Existing results, priorities, and evidence remain unchanged.

groups.title: Mouse, keyboard, and scroll activity did not renew the session
groups.reason: Continuous mouse movement keeps restarting the five-second timer. Keyboard and scroll actions have no session-renewal connection.
groups.user_impact: The session did not renew during these tests. Later sign-out, interrupted work, and lost work were not observed.
groups.next_action: Keep these cases in the backlog. Repeat them when the agreed activity behavior is implemented.

groups.title: Signing out did not stop the session from being renewed
groups.reason: The server reported successful sign-out but did not invalidate the saved credential used to renew the session.
groups.user_impact: The same valid credential obtained new access after sign-out. Production exposure has not been verified.
groups.next_action: Fix sign-out so the saved credential cannot renew access. Otherwise, prove this release cannot reach the failing path.

groups.title: The loading indicator disappeared before all work finished
groups.reason: One request failed while another was waiting. Error handling removed the loading indication for both requests.
groups.user_impact: The screen appeared ready while work remained pending. No session interruption, repeated submission, or data loss was demonstrated.
groups.next_action: Keep the visual defect in the backlog. Raise its priority if it causes a blocked action or incorrect saved data.

groups.title: A request with two different renewal credentials was accepted
groups.reason: The server used the first credential instead of rejecting the conflicting values. The rejection rule still needs review.
groups.user_impact: The test received access for the first identity. It did not demonstrate access to another user’s account.
groups.next_action: Agree how conflicting credentials must be handled. Then test the complete request through the real server entry point.

groups.title: A request to another website included the portal sign-in credential
groups.reason: The shared request code added the portal credential to a request addressed to an external test website.
groups.user_impact: The test stopped the request before delivery. No external website received the credential.
groups.next_action: Find whether supported application code makes such requests. Check that external destinations never receive portal credentials.

groups.title: A special request setting skipped the sign-in check
groups.reason: A configured request header let the test service continue without a valid sign-in credential.
groups.user_impact: The test reached a protected test function. Access to real business data was not demonstrated.
groups.next_action: Check whether public requests can set this header. Verify that real services reject attempts to bypass sign-in.

groups.title: Combined scenarios did not check real business saves
groups.reason: The tests checked browser and session behavior. No real business service or saved-transaction record was available.
groups.user_impact: The tests did not prove whether unauthorized or duplicate saves are prevented. They did not demonstrate a harmful save.
groups.next_action: Repeat these scenarios with a real business action. Check permissions and server records for each completed save.

groups.title: The cleanup comparison used different page states
groups.reason: Notifications and other page elements differed before and after the test. Their event-handler counts could not be compared fairly.
groups.user_impact: No memory leak, repeated action, forced sign-out, or unusable screen was proved.
groups.next_action: Repeat the comparison with matching page contents. Check that unused event handlers and timers are removed.

groups.title: The browser renewed access, but real server access was not checked
groups.reason: The browser accepted the test credential. The replacement test service did not perform the real server’s security checks.
groups.user_impact: The result does not prove that users can open protected business services after renewal.
groups.next_action: Repeat each case with valid credentials from the real sign-in service. Confirm access as the correct user.

groups.title: Real browser suspension and private-window behavior remain unchecked
groups.reason: The tests imitated some browser conditions. They did not complete the required suspension or normal/private-window session sequence.
groups.user_impact: No disruptive user effect was demonstrated. Behavior in the specified real browser conditions remains unknown.
groups.next_action: Repeat the complete sequence in the specified browser mode. Check session recovery and access to protected services.

groups.title: The tests did not include the real live-update connection
groups.reason: The tests used local observations or imitated notifications. The actual connected application and receiving service were unavailable.
groups.user_impact: Renewal and credential handling during real updates or reconnects remain unverified. No production failure was demonstrated.
groups.next_action: Connect the real application to an isolated test service. Check messages, reconnection, session renewal, and credential handling.

groups.title: Browser observations were not checked against real saved records
groups.reason: The browser checks ran, but real application records and server completion records were unavailable.
groups.user_impact: The tests cannot confirm saved-data integrity, one completed save, or completion after a tab closes.
groups.next_action: Repeat with the real application. Compare browser actions with the server’s saved records and completion history.

groups.title: A test credential appeared in debugging output
groups.reason: A failed renewal printed a test credential in the browser console. Exported logs and their readers were not checked.
groups.user_impact: The test does not establish whether real credentials reach unauthorized readers. Exposure remains unverified.
groups.next_action: Identify which logs leave the browser and who can read them. Check that sensitive credentials are removed.

groups.title: Four simulated hours passed, but the real sign-in service was not used
groups.reason: The test advanced the clock through four hours. It used replacement sign-in and protected-service responses.
groups.user_impact: No local sign-in prompt appeared. Continued access with the real sign-in provider remains unverified.
groups.next_action: Repeat the interval with the real sign-in provider and protected service. Record any new sign-in prompt and its cause.

groups.title: The required live-message services were unavailable
groups.reason: The test environment lacked the actual live-update application, signed-in connection, or server delivery records.
groups.user_impact: Message delivery, reconnection, duplication, and access after sign-out could not be checked. This does not prove an application failure.
groups.next_action: Provide the required test application and message service. Check the expected users, messages, and permission rules.

groups.title: The required application or user permissions were unavailable
groups.reason: The environment lacked a required application, supported host, separate user permissions, or protected business records.
groups.user_impact: The tests could not check data separation, removed permissions, or host-specific behavior. No application failure was demonstrated.
groups.next_action: Provide the specified application setup and protected records. Use separate test users with the required permissions.

groups.title: The required browser, device, or desktop condition was unavailable
groups.reason: The runner could not perform the specified touch, keyboard-input, crash, sleep, VPN, multiple-device, or desktop sequence.
groups.user_impact: Recovery in these real conditions remains unknown. Imitated browser events do not prove the same behavior.
groups.next_action: Run each case in its specified environment. Check restored sessions and protected access after the event.

groups.title: The real browser and server security setup was unavailable
groups.reason: The tests lacked the required website, request headers, cookies, shared sign-out handling, or caching server.
groups.user_impact: Cross-site access, embedded pages, shared sign-out, and cached-data separation remain unchecked. No user failure was demonstrated.
groups.next_action: Provide an isolated copy of the relevant server setup. Test the actual browser and server rules together.

groups.title: The required saving, upload, or background-work service was unavailable
groups.reason: The test environment lacked the specified business action, upload service, progress updates, background task, or saved-result record.
groups.user_impact: Duplicate saves, upload permissions, background activity after sign-out, and cached user data remain unchecked.
groups.next_action: Provide the real test service and server records. Verify permissions, completion, cancellation, and separation between users.

groups.title: A secure-connection failure could not be tested
groups.reason: The local service used an unencrypted connection. No controlled HTTPS certificate or connection failure was available.
groups.user_impact: The tests cannot confirm secure rejection or prove that credentials avoid an unencrypted fallback.
groups.next_action: Provide a controlled HTTPS service with the required failure. Check rejection and safe handling of sign-in credentials.

groups.title: The complete service or repeated-recovery test was unavailable
groups.reason: Some browser actions ran. Real server checks or the exact repeated sign-in and page-cleanup sequence were missing.
groups.user_impact: Reloading or reconnecting alone does not prove protected access, expired-credential rejection, or cleanup across repeated recoveries.
groups.next_action: Provide the real server checks and required repeated sequence. Complete the missing access and cleanup checks.

reviews.title: A new session can remain trapped behind the old expiry dialog
reviews.what_happened: A replacement sign-in completed while sign-out was still waiting. The old expiry dialog remained open.
reviews.reason: The code protected the new session but left the old dialog unchanged. Extend was disabled, and Logout did nothing.
reviews.user_impact: The valid new session could not continue through the visible recovery controls in this browser test.
reviews.missing_check: A supported production path that replaces the session in place has not been identified.
reviews.priority_reason: P2 remains because the test demonstrated unusable recovery controls. Production reachability remains unknown.
reviews.next_action: Find whether a supported application can trigger this timing. If so, close the old dialog and repeat the test.
reviews.limits: The browser test used an earlier candidate. Relevant current code is unchanged, but the current candidate was not rerun.

reviews.title: Renewal rejects credentials without the expected time fields
reviews.what_happened: Test responses supplied credentials with an unsupported format or missing creation time. Renewal rejected them.
reviews.reason: The new checks require usable creation and expiry times. The inspected local sign-in provider supplies those fields.
reviews.user_impact: A valid retry succeeded in the same dialog. A supported response that prevents recovery was not demonstrated.
reviews.missing_check: The deployed provider’s supported credential format still needs confirmation.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because the failed inputs were test substitutes and valid retry recovered.
reviews.next_action: Confirm the provider’s supported response format. Raise priority if a valid response prevents session renewal.
reviews.limits: The browser checked controlled response substitutions. Production provider behavior was not verified.

reviews.title: A failed new sign-in cleared renewal data, but recovery succeeded
reviews.what_happened: Starting a new sign-in cleared the old renewal credential. That new sign-in then failed.
reviews.reason: The session changed before the new sign-in completed. The portal later obtained a renewal credential again.
reviews.user_impact: Extend recovered the session and protected access succeeded. The suspected recovery block was not reproduced.
reviews.missing_check: The complete range of supported failed-sign-in paths remains untested.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because the demonstrated browser sequence recovered successfully.
reviews.next_action: Retain the successful recovery result. Raise priority if a supported failed-sign-in path leaves the user unable to continue.
reviews.limits: This is an earlier controlled browser comparison. Production frequency and behavior remain unverified.

reviews.title: Direct credential replacement can leave old renewal data behind
reviews.what_happened: Test code directly replaced the access credential. The previous renewal credential remained.
reviews.reason: This direct update skips the normal new-sign-in transition. No supported application using that update was found.
reviews.user_impact: The test used one identity. Access to another user’s account or records was not demonstrated.
reviews.missing_check: A supported caller and a test with two distinct users are still needed.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because a consequential user effect has not been demonstrated.
reviews.next_action: Find supported code that replaces credentials directly. Test a complete transition between two separate users.
reviews.limits: This observation used an earlier candidate and one local identity. Production reachability remains unknown.

reviews.title: Extend waits while renewal credentials are being obtained
reviews.what_happened: The request for a renewal credential remained pending. The dialog disabled Extend while waiting for it.
reviews.reason: The portal waits for the request to finish before allowing another renewal attempt.
reviews.user_impact: Logout remained available. When the pending request failed, the user reached Sign In.
reviews.missing_check: Actual waiting time during browser suspension remains unverified.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because an unusable dialog or unlimited wait was not demonstrated.
reviews.next_action: Measure real waiting time if supported use shows prolonged or unusable recovery.
reviews.limits: The browser held the request in a controlled test. Production delays were not measured.

reviews.title: An invalid credential without an expiry time caused sign-out
reviews.what_happened: The test supplied a renewal credential without an expiry time and with an invalid signature. The portal signed out.
reviews.reason: The portal cannot determine a safe renewal window from that credential. The inspected local provider never creates this format.
reviews.user_impact: Sign-out was observed for the invalid test input. Forced sign-out from a valid supported credential was not demonstrated.
reviews.missing_check: Confirm that the deployed provider follows the inspected validity rules.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because the disruptive result used an invalid input that the inspected provider does not issue.
reviews.next_action: Check supported credential rules. Raise priority if a valid provider response unexpectedly signs the user out.
reviews.limits: The response was deliberately altered in a controlled browser test. Production occurrence remains unverified.

reviews.title: Recovery still worked when the page opened near credential expiry
reviews.what_happened: The page opened with less than 25 seconds of access remaining and a usable renewal credential.
reviews.reason: The candidate did not immediately repeat the missed scheduled request. Manual Extend still obtained usable access.
reviews.user_impact: Renewal and protected access succeeded. The suspected recovery block was not reproduced.
reviews.missing_check: Other timing conditions remain outside this test.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because the tested recovery succeeded.
reviews.next_action: Retain the successful recovery result. Investigate further if a supported timing condition disrupts the session.
reviews.limits: This was an earlier controlled browser comparison. The result does not establish every production timing condition.

reviews.title: A file-loading setting may point to the user’s own computer
reviews.what_happened: The inspected build setting can use a local computer address for additional application files.
reviews.reason: The source rule already existed. Its effective value in a deployed build was not available.
reviews.user_impact: A matching file-loading failure was not demonstrated. Users could be affected only if a released build uses that address.
reviews.missing_check: The actual settings and file addresses used by a relevant deployment remain unknown.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because no applicable application-loading failure has been shown.
reviews.next_action: Inspect the effective setting when a matching deployment or supported loading failure becomes available.
reviews.limits: This is a configuration concern from code inspection. Release artifacts are outside this report’s scope.
reviews.owner: Release or maintenance owner not assigned.

reviews.title: A setting names a development version of another application
reviews.what_happened: The source configuration refers to another application at a development address.
reviews.reason: No supported application was identified that actually loads that address.
reviews.user_impact: The setting alone does not demonstrate a broken application or a user reaching the wrong version.
reviews.missing_check: The actual consuming application and deployed address remain unidentified.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because no affected user journey has been demonstrated.
reviews.next_action: Identify application code that uses the setting before treating it as a release blocker.

reviews.owner: Release or maintenance owner not assigned.

reviews.title: A request-size setting evaluates to one byte
reviews.what_happened: The inspected setting allows only one byte of request data when interpreted by the existing parser.
reviews.reason: No supported server operation that uses this limit was identified.
reviews.user_impact: The setting could reject larger requests if such an operation uses it. No rejected business action was demonstrated.
reviews.missing_check: A supported operation using the setting and its effective deployment value remain unknown.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because the code calculation has no demonstrated user consequence.
reviews.next_action: Identify a supported operation using the limit. Check its actual request size and observable result.
reviews.limits: The parser calculation was inspected. No matching live business operation was tested.

reviews.title: Some external build instructions were unavailable
reviews.what_happened: The build refers to instructions stored elsewhere. Their exact contents were unavailable for inspection.
reviews.reason: The missing instructions prevent a complete build review. They do not establish a broken application.
reviews.user_impact: No user failure was demonstrated by this missing information.
reviews.missing_check: The exact external instructions remain unavailable.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because this is a review gap outside the requested source assessment.
reviews.next_action: Keep the gap recorded. Revisit it during an authorized build assessment or after a demonstrated runtime failure.

reviews.title: The suspected stuck loading indicator did not occur
reviews.what_happened: The browser received the tested sign-in error. The loading indicator cleared and Sign In remained usable.
reviews.reason: The actual tested error path did not reproduce the suspected persistent loading state.
reviews.user_impact: No blocked sign-in action was observed. Other delayed-response sequences remain unchecked.
reviews.missing_check: A different supported sequence that leaves the indicator stuck has not been demonstrated.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because the tested recovery worked.
reviews.next_action: Retain this recovery result. Investigate another sequence if it visibly prevents an action.
reviews.limits: This earlier browser result covers one sign-in error sequence. It does not cover every delayed response.

reviews.title: One failed request can hide another request’s loading indicator
reviews.what_happened: Current testing showed the loading indicator disappear while a separate request was still waiting.
reviews.reason: Some errors do not identify the failed request. The shared cleanup then removes every request’s loading indication.
reviews.user_impact: The observed effect is visual. No forced sign-out, unusable action, duplicate save, or data loss was demonstrated.
reviews.missing_check: The frequency and user consequence in supported production flows remain unknown.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because no material user disruption was demonstrated.
reviews.next_action: Track the visual defect in the backlog. Raise priority if it causes a blocked action or incorrect saved data.
reviews.limits: This finding overlaps RN-Q009. The original review had not reached this error; the later test demonstrated the visual effect.

reviews.title: Applications must handle responses canceled after a session changes
reviews.what_happened: A response from an earlier session is rejected as canceled after the session changes.
reviews.reason: The new session protection rejects old results. Application code must handle that cancellation.
reviews.user_impact: Known local application code handles the cancellation. No affected user journey was identified.
reviews.missing_check: No supported application that mishandles the canceled response has been identified.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because a real downstream failure has not been demonstrated.
reviews.next_action: Find a supported application that fails to handle cancellation before raising priority.
reviews.limits: The code behavior was inspected. A failing external application was not available for execution.

reviews.title: Applications must handle failed renewal requests
reviews.what_happened: The renewal helper now reports a rejected request to the application that called it.
reviews.reason: The expiry dialog handles this failure. Other applications must also handle it if they use the helper.
reviews.user_impact: No external application or unusable user journey was identified. The known expiry dialog handles the error.
reviews.missing_check: A supported application that fails to handle renewal errors has not been identified.
reviews.priority_reason: P3 remains because no consequential user failure has been demonstrated.
reviews.next_action: Investigate supported applications if an unhandled renewal error causes a user-visible failure.
reviews.limits: This is an interface change found in code review. No affected external application was tested.

reviews.title: Canceled requests return a different error object
reviews.what_happened: Cancellation returns the original error object. Other failures return a copied error object.
reviews.reason: The difference matters only to application code that depends on the exact object being returned.
reviews.user_impact: No application with that dependency was found. No user effect was demonstrated.
reviews.missing_check: An affected supported application has not been identified.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because the difference has no demonstrated business effect.
reviews.next_action: Keep this code-interface difference in the backlog. Reassess if a supported application fails because of it.
reviews.limits: This is a code-level observation. No affected consumer was available for a user-flow test.

reviews.title: A renewal response arriving after expiry still restored access
reviews.what_happened: The service accepted renewal before expiry. Its successful response reached the browser after the deadline.
reviews.reason: The browser installed the accepted credential and protected access succeeded. A much longer delay separately reached a timeout.
reviews.user_impact: The suspected recovery failure was not reproduced for the accepted late response.
reviews.missing_check: Other provider timing rules and production delays remain unverified.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because the tested late response restored usable access.
reviews.next_action: Retain the successful result. Raise priority if a supported delayed response interrupts the session.
reviews.limits: This was an earlier controlled browser comparison. It does not establish every provider’s late-renewal policy.

reviews.title: A formatting ignore rule contains a typo

reviews.reason: No tracked file or formatting command affected by this typo was found.
reviews.user_impact: No business behavior or user journey was affected in the retained evidence.
reviews.missing_check: No applicable file or command has been identified.
reviews.priority_reason: P4 remains because this is a maintenance issue without demonstrated user impact.

issues.title: Signing out does not fully end the session
issues.what_happened: The server reported successful sign-out. The same valid refresh credential could still obtain new access after the access credential expired.
issues.reason: The sign-out code did not record that the session had ended. It recorded zero entries to prevent further renewal.
issues.user_impact: Someone already holding a copied refresh credential could regain access after sign-out. No real account compromise was demonstrated.
issues.missing_check: Show that sign-out prevents further renewal, or show that this release cannot reach the failing code.
issues.priority_reason: P1 remains because the test proves a broken sign-out security boundary. This is the release blocker.
issues.next_action: Correct the sign-out code or prove it cannot affect this release. Then repeat the renewal attempt after sign-out.
issues.limits: The test ran real server authentication code with stand-in storage and other services. It did not test a production deployment.
issues.owner: Authentication owner not assigned.

issues.title: An old timeout window can block a new session
issues.what_happened: A new login succeeded before an earlier sign-out action finished. The old timeout window stayed open with unusable buttons.
issues.reason: The code protected the new login from the old sign-out action. It did not close the old timeout window.
issues.user_impact: The browser test left a valid new session behind a window that could not recover the workspace.
issues.missing_check: Confirm whether a supported application can start a new login during this short sign-out delay.
issues.priority_reason: P2 remains because the browser test showed blocked recovery. Whether a deployed application can trigger it remains unknown.
issues.next_action: Check supported login flows. If this timing is possible, correct the timeout window and repeat the browser test.
issues.limits: The browser test used an earlier candidate. The relevant logic is unchanged, but the current candidate was not retested.

issues.title: A delayed error can clear a renewed session
issues.what_happened: An earlier request returned an expired-session error after renewal succeeded. The app then removed the newly renewed access and refresh credentials.
issues.reason: The app treated the delayed error as a failure of the renewed session. It displayed a sign-in-again error.
issues.user_impact: Users could be asked to sign in again after successful renewal. An actual forced logout was not observed.
issues.missing_check: Confirm that a supported server can return this error at this time. Then check the complete browser journey.
issues.priority_reason: P2 remains because the test removed valid renewed credentials. Whether real services produce this sequence remains unknown.
issues.next_action: Repeat the sequence with a supported server and application. Check that an old error cannot erase a valid renewed session.
issues.limits: The test ran the app's session code with controlled responses and a test clock. It used no live business service.
issues.owner: Application and authentication owners not assigned.

issues.title: Sign-out reported success when saving the session revocation failed
issues.what_happened: Saving the sign-out record failed. The server still reported success, and the same valid renewal credential obtained new access.
issues.reason: Sign-out success did not require a saved record that prevented further session renewal.
issues.user_impact: Someone already holding the valid renewal credential could regain access after apparent sign-out. Production exposure remains unverified.
issues.missing_check: Show that sign-out reliably prevents renewal, or reports failure when it cannot end the session.
issues.priority_reason: P1 remains because this demonstrates the same broken sign-out security boundary as RN-S002. It is not a separate blocker.
issues.next_action: Correct sign-out handling. Repeat the storage-failure test and confirm that subsequent renewal is rejected.
issues.limits: This retained local observation proves behavior under controlled conditions. Production reachability and frequency remain unverified.
issues.owner: Authentication owner not assigned.

issues.title: Sign-out without an access credential left renewal possible

issues.limits: This retained local observation does not prove production reachability or credential theft.
